messages:
ashley: Heads-up — AcmeMaps started seeing index rejects right after they pinned their workspace to ai-embed-v2-quant@2026-03-16. Error: "vector length mismatch: expected 1024, got 1536". Request id: req_1b2c3d

maria: Reported failure rate ~2.7% of batch writes, spike started at 03:12 UTC when pin rolled out for that customer only. They temporarily unpinned and failures stopped.

jamal: Can you paste one raw embedding response and the exact pin string from the console? Need to confirm the model metadata.

ashley: Console shows: ai-embed-v2-quant@2026-03-16. Sample captured from their failing write: ```{
  "model": "ai-embed-v2-quant",
  "embedding_len": 1536,
  "embedding": [0.0009, 0.023, ...],
  "request_id": "req_1b2c3d"
}```

eli: Ran a quick repro from hosted endpoint: calling model ai-embed-v2-quant returns 1536-length vectors. Calling ai-embed-v2 (unpinned latest) returns 1024. Looks like the quant packaging changed the vector size.

eli: Repro curl I used: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"ai-embed-v2-quant","input":"x"}' | jq '.embedding | length'```

sophia: Eng-ML triage: packager job updated parameter merging that increases hidden_size for the quant artifact. Tokenizer mapping unchanged, but hidden dims were altered during the merge step. This is a packaging-time change, not a runtime transform.

jamal: This should have been a breaking-version bump. We cannot alter embedding_dim and keep the same public model name. We need rollback and stronger checks in the packager. Who owns the packager run?

eli: Packager job runs in ml-packager pipeline. Last run 2026-03-16 02:58 UTC, commit abcdef12. I attached packager logs to the internal ticket.

maria: Customer needs immediate mitigation: they cannot tolerate writes failing. They asked for either (a) repin to a known-good model snapshot or (b) a compatibility shim in the runtime to downsample/pad.

ashley: Short-term support action: we offered to repin their workspace to ai-embed-v2@2026-03-15 (pre-quant build). They accepted a temporary repin while we investigate.

jamal: Action plan: (1) ENG-ML P1: revert packager commit that changed hidden_size and re-publish quant variant with a new model name or explicit breaking-version (2) Support P1: console action to repin affected workspaces to pre-quant snapshot (3) Runtime P2: add guard that refuses pin if embedding_dim disagrees with customer's index expectation unless overridden.

eli: Proposed runtime guard details: when a workspace tries to pin a model, check model metadata field "embedding_dim" against workspace metadata / index schema. If mismatch, present a descriptive error and require explicit opt-in to force pin. Low-risk, can be done within 48h.

sophia: Also recommend packager emits a manifest with fields: model_name, version_tag, embedding_dim, quantized: true/false, created_at. Console and API should surface embedding_dim to users during pinning.

ashley: Created support ticket SUP-4621 for AcmeMaps. Included repro curl, sample response, and suggested repin instructions. Ticket notes customer impact and that unpin resolved the errors.

maria: Customer success asked for migration doc we can send them: options are (A) full re-embed with the new model (recommended) or (B) best-effort pad/truncate to 1024 for existing index (quality loss). They want clear instructions and example scripts.

eli: I'll draft migration snippet for re-embedding and a small python helper to pad/truncate if they absolutely cannot re-embed. Will attach to the ticket.

infra-bot: deploy_bot: scheduled rollback job for ml-packager if ENG approves the revert patch.

jamal: I'll file ENG-ML issue and add eli + sophia as assignees. Prioritizing packager revert. Will keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup: 

ashley: Updating AcmeMaps now with repin steps and ETA. I'll follow up once ENG-ML confirms rollback timeline and when runtime guard lands.
